title: מתנקשת סגולה
summary: הסטרימרית קמה מהכיסא והופכת ללוחמת מכושפת בשריון שחור-זהב עם עיניים ורונות זוהרות בסגול.

phases.what: Eyes flash with purple lightning while sitting
Dark smoke appears at neck, metallic mask and shoulder armor form
Stands up as full hooded dark armor with glowing purple runes materializes
Steps forward, dark smoke swirls, glowing purple magic circle appears behind head
Raises right hand channeling purple lightning energy

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and suddenly their eyes flash with bright purple lightning. Keep the person recognizable until the mask covers the face. Dark smoke rises around their neck as a metallic fantasy mask with glowing purple eyes and dark shoulder armor materialize over them. They stand up from their chair as full black and gold ornate armor with a dark hood and glowing purple runes spreads across their entire body. Stepping forward, dark smoke swirls around their legs, floating purple crystals appear, and a large glowing purple arcane circle materializes behind their head. They raise one gloved hand, crackling with purple lightning. Dark cinematic lighting with vibrant purple neon glow, vertical framing.
